description: DealCloud provides a REST API accessed via OAuth2 client credentials using an API key and scoped bearer tokens.

evidence.claim: DealCloud uses OAuth2 Client Credentials flow for authentication
DealCloud API endpoints are accessed via REST URLs (e.g., api/rest/v1/...)
Obtaining an API key requires user group permissions set by an admin, indicating gated credential access
DealCloud offers multiple scoped APIs covering user management, data, publications, relationship intelligence import, and backups, indicating broad API coverage
DealCloud API can be integrated using standard OAuth2 token flow, indicating possible buildability
